The '''Mon Calamari system''', also known as the '''Calamari system''', the '''Mon Cal system''', and the '''Dac system''', was an eight-planet [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was the home of the planet [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. It was the capital system of the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TEA" />
